title: cap-table sweep.json
description: A parametric pre-money sweep: K real priced-round solver frames the explorer slider scrubs between. Every frame is real solver output; the slider snaps to discrete frames so no fabricated in-between ownership is shown.

axis.description: The swept parameter. v1 supports pre_money only.

base_scenario_id.description: The priced_round scenario the sweep was derived from, or null when none was eligible.

note.description: Present only when no sweep was generated (no eligible base scenario).

frames.description: Ordered low->high pre_money. Each frame is a real solver output; new_money is held fixed across frames.

valid.description: True only when the frame solved to full/mixed completeness with no blockers; the slider skips invalid frames.

outputs.description: Trimmed computed_outputs: only the fields the slider view consumes (aggregate, price, post-FD shares, shares_breakdown, completeness, blockers).
